brief.headline: Lock in your ₹66.48/KG price but pull payment back to 15 days — your size (1.36% of their sales) and their debt (2.25x) give you the room.

priceAsk.summary: Hold the current ₹66.48/KG — it's already market-fair.
priceAsk.basis: The market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our price sits right in that band (verdict: MARKET-FAIR, slightly favourable). No saving to chase here; focus the ask on payment terms instead.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days to 15 days after receipt — offer it as a win for them (faster cash) in exchange for locking volume or a small rebate.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Cutting 15 days frees up ₹61.76 L of our cash to use elsewhere.

brief.financialLeverage: They make ₹1102.11 Cr in sales but keep only 2.3% as profit — roughly ₹2 for every ₹100 they sell — so there's no fat to squeeze on price. But they owe 2.25x their own cash (₹238.85 Cr in debt), which means they value getting paid quickly. Your ₹15.03 Cr spend is 1.36% of everything they sell — a meaningful customer — so you can push on terms without risking supply. Lead with faster payment (worth cash to them) tied to a volume commitment or a small rebate, not a price cut that could hurt a thin-margin supplier.

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health B (62/100) — a strong drop-in alternate with better financial strength; qualify and benchmark price.

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist, ₹821.13 Cr revenue, health C (53/100) — growing capacity in dextrose; a credible second source to test.

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore wet-miller, ₹365.39 Cr revenue, makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; confirm IP monograph CoA before switching.

risks: Their thin profit (2.3%) and heavy debt (2.25x) mean a hard price squeeze could destabilize supply — keep the ask on payment terms, not price.
Health score D (21/100) flags weak financials — line up Gulshan Polyols or Sanstar now as backup so you're not caught if they stumble.
We already pay the best price in our book (₹66.48/KG) and it's market-fair — pushing lower has no data support and risks the relationship.
Faster payment (15 days) is worth cash to them, but tie it to a volume lock or small rebate so we don't give it away for nothing.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: You're an important supplier — 1.36% of your revenue comes from us — so let's talk about how we can both win: we move to 15-day payment to help your cash flow, and you lock our volume with a small rebate or priority delivery.
